verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्तेषु राज्ञा तु पाण्डुपुत्रेषु भारत। दुर्योधनः परं हर्षमगच्छत्स दुरात्मवान्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, when the king thus addressed the sons of Pandu, the wickedminded Duryodhana became exceedingly happy. O best of the Bharata race, he summoned in private, Purochana and taking up his right hand, he thus spoke to that counsellor. O Purochana, this world, full of wealth, is mine. It is equally yours with me. (Therefore), you should protect it. I have no other more trustworthy supporter and counsellor than you with whom I can consult.

verses.sanskrit: स पुरोचनमेकान्तमानीय भरतर्षभ । गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे पाणौ सचिवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥२॥
ममेयं वसुसंपूर्णा पुरोचन वसुंधरा। यथेयं मम तद्वत्ते स तां रक्षितुमर्हसि॥३॥
न हि मे कश्चिदन्यास्ति विश्वासिकतरस्त्वया। सहायो येन संधाय मन्त्रयेयं यथा त्वया॥४॥
संरक्ष तात मन्त्रं च सपत्नांश्च भमोद्धर। निपुणेनाभ्युपायेन यद्ब्रवीमि तथा कुरु॥५॥
verses.english: O sire, keep my counsel (a secret) and destroy my enemy by some clever device. Accomplish, what I ask you to do.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवा धृतराष्ट्रेण प्रेषिता वारणावतम्। उत्सवे विहरिष्यन्ति धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥६॥
verses.english: The Pandavas have been sent by Dhritarashtra to Varanavata. They will sport there in the festival at the command of Dhritarashtra.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं रासभयुक्तेन स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना। वारणावतमद्यैव यथा यासि तथा कुरु॥७॥
verses.english: Do that by with you can reach Varanavata this very day on a car drawn by swift asses.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र गत्वा चतुःशालं गृहं परमसंवृतम् । नगरोपान्तमाश्रित्य कारयेथा महाधनम्॥८॥
verses.english: Going there, erect a quadrangle palace at the outskirts of the city, (which should be) rich in materials and furniture. Guard it (also) well.

verses.sanskrit: शणसर्जरसादीनि यानि द्रव्याणि कानिचित्। आग्नेयान्युत सन्तीह तानि तत्र प्रदापय॥९॥
verses.english: Use in it (in erecting that house,) hemp, resin and all other inflammable materials that are procurable.

verses.sanskrit: सर्पिस्तैलवसाभिश्च लाक्षया चाप्यनल्पया। मृत्तिकां मिश्रयित्वा त्वं लेपं कुड्येषु दापय॥१०॥
verses.english: Mixing a little earth with ghee, oil, fat and a large quantity of lac, plaster the wall with it.

verses.sanskrit: शणं तैलं घृतं चैव जतु दारूणि चैव हि। तस्मिन्वेश्मनि सर्वाणि निक्षिपेथाः समन्ततः ॥११॥
verses.english: Place carefully all over that house hemp, oil, ghee, lac and wood. In such a way that the Pandavas and other men may not even with scrutiny see them or conclude that it is made of inflammable materials. Erecting such a house and worshipping the Pandavas with great reverence, make them live in it with Kunti and all their friends.

verses.sanskrit: यथा च तन्न पश्येरन्परोक्षन्तोऽपि पाण्डवाः। आग्नेयमिति तत्कार्यमपि चान्येऽपि मानवाः ॥१२॥
वेश्मन्येवं कृते तत्र गत्वा तान्परमार्चितान्। वासयेथाः पाण्डवेयान्कुन्ती च ससुहृज्जनाम्॥१३॥
आसनानि च दिव्यानि यानानि शयनानि च। विधातव्यानि पाण्डूनां यथा तुष्येत वै पिता॥१४॥
verses.english: Place there for the Pandavas seats, conveyances and beds of best workmanship, as ordered my father. Manage all this in a way so that none in the city of Varanavata may know it, till the end we have in view is accomplished.

verses.sanskrit: यथा च तन्न जानन्ति नगरे वारणावते। तथा सर्वं विधातव्यं यावत्कालस्य पर्ययः॥१५॥
ज्ञात्वा च तान्सुविश्वस्तान् शयानानकुतोभयान्। अग्निस्त्वया ततो देयो द्वारतस्तस्य वेश्मनः॥१६॥
verses.english: Knowing that they are sleeping in that house in confidence and without fear, set fire to it, beginning from the gate.

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमाने स्वके गेहे दग्धा इति ततो जनाः। न गर्हयेयुरस्मान्वै पाण्डवार्थाय कर्हिचित्॥१७॥
verses.english: The people will think that they have been burnt to death in that burning house; and therefore none will be able to blame us for the death of the Pandavas,

verses.sanskrit: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय कौरवाय पुरोचनः। प्रायाद्रासभयुक्तेन स्यन्दनेनाशुगामिना॥१८॥
verses.english: Purochana promised to that Kaurava (Duryodhana) to carry out all by saying, “Be it so" and he then went (away) on a swift car drawn by asses.

verses.sanskrit: स गत्वा त्वरितं राजन्दुर्योधनमते स्थितः। यथोक्तं राजपुत्रेण सर्वे चक्रे पुरोचनः॥१९॥
verses.english: O king, ever obedient to Duryodhana, he went without loss of time. Purochana did all that the prince said, (asked him to do).
